items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Wild
items.detail: A Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P. can produce it, or find it at The Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Collect Toilet Paper
items.detail: Check a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron or find it in the red brick maintenance building at The Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Craft any Flair at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Craft any Flair under Souvenirs category; requires a learned Flair plan.

items.title: Kill a Cryptid
items.detail: Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go has up to three Snallygasters spawning ahead of the fast travel point.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Energy Weapon
items.detail: Head to Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center where low-level robots spawn reliably.

items.title: Mod a Weapon
items.detail: Apply or swap any known mod at a weapons workbench; changing a weapon skin counts.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Cork
items.detail: Craft Bulk Cork at a Tinker's Workbench in your C.A.M.P. or at The Whitespring Resort, then scrap it.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap under Defense in build menu; a Punji Board costs only 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs region; look for unusual orange bulbs or plant it in your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Start the Strange Brew Daily Quest at the Giant Teapot to kill bees, or go to Tanagra Town for up to ten Cave Crickets.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Only appears during the Slasher seasonal event's last stage as an uninvited guest at a Head Hunt.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 Cultists; target the head with V.A.T.S. for faster kills.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Grab a Protest Sign and degrade it, then repair it at a workbench with just one Wood each time.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it, or scrap items that contain acid.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or other junk containing crystal at any workbench.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprint over open ground with few enemies to reach 50 KM.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events are mutated with enhanced challenges and special rewards from Mutated Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn double XP while leveling up and progressing through the Scoreboard.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event runs alongside double mutation rates for legendary enemies.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Limited-time event featuring holiday-themed Scorched enemies and special gift rewards.
